study: mLSTM, DeltaNet and user-specified Bayesian Layer extension
interpretation: Additional comparisons on the same established benchmark, not a new unseen external test
selection_rule: Validation AUC, then AP and ACC; never tune configurations from extension test scores

matrix_confirmation.configuration: Best seed-1 validation configuration within each encoder family

state_memory: Persistent matrix states add memory beyond the common 172-dimensional output. Report actual buffer bytes; do not claim equal state memory

bayesian.status: User delegated paper choice; selected Bayes by Backprop Gaussian variational encoder layer
bayesian.implementation: Bayesian minGRU candidate input projection; deterministic gate/residual/MLP decoder
bayesian.training_sampling: One weight draw per BPTT window, KL divided by all epoch queries
bayesian.evaluation_sampling: Independent full-prefix replay per fixed posterior draw; mean sigmoid probability
